elsewhere.note: After they had hoisted it up, they used cables to help reinforce the ship. Fearing that they would run aground on the Syrtis sand bars, they lowered the sea…
Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
